createdAt.description: When the group was created. Rewriting the declaration keeps this date.

aboutSpace.description: The group's about space, which holds its profile and rules: at://<group DID>/space/<space type>/<space key>. Reading it needs a credential.

main.description: Marks this account as a group and points at its about space. It carries nothing else. A group has one only while it is public; it is deleted when the group becomes private.
